skill.name: executor-execution
skill.description: Use when a plan under docs/executor/*/plans/ has passed its planning gate and the human has picked an execution mode, or when resuming a plan run whose ledger shows tasks incomplete or mid-fix-loop.
skill.summary: Coordinate approved implementation plans with task subagents, review gates, durable ledgers, and bounded fix rounds.
skill.author: atri10

content.user_title: Execute Approved Plans with Subagents and Reviews
content.value_statement: Long implementation plans can lose task state and accumulate unreviewed changes. This skill coordinates scoped subagents, review gates, and durable records across execution and recovery.
actual_capabilities: Defines Git workspace isolation checks and review-gated task branch workflows.
Coordinates task briefs and context files through declared sibling Executor helpers.
Provides implementer dispatch templates with scope limits, evidence requirements, and escalation statuses.
Defines task reviews, five-round fix limits, model escalation, and final branch review.
Tracks task states, agent dispatches, and rulings in durable local records for interrupted runs.
Requires secret redaction, completion checks, and verification before human handoff.
limitations: Requires sibling Executor scripts and review, verification, and handoff skills that are not included in this package.
Requires an approved plan, task identifiers, a reachable specification, and a supported subagent environment.
Provides workflow instructions and templates, not a standalone execution engine or guaranteed implementation quality.
May leave recorded deferred findings; final completion does not automatically authorize merging, pushing, or publishing.

use_cases.title: Implement a reviewed feature plan
use_cases.description: Coordinate scoped implementation tasks, collect test evidence, and review each task before integration.

use_cases.title: Resume an interrupted plan
use_cases.description: Reconcile the ledger, branch state, and recorded dispatches before continuing incomplete tasks or fix rounds.

use_cases.title: Prepare an auditable implementation handoff
use_cases.description: Organize review records, rulings, deferred findings, and verification results for a human release decision.

prompt_templates.title: Begin an approved plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute the approved plan at [PLAN_PATH] in subagent mode. Confirm workspace isolation and prerequisites, then coordinate task implementation and review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start a prepared implementation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Resume incomplete work
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [PLAN_PATH]. Check the ledger, dispatch records, and branch state. Continue the first incomplete task without repeating completed work.

prompt_templates.title: Continue a scoped fix round
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the review fix loop for [TASK_ID] in [PLAN_PATH]. Use recorded findings, require root-cause evidence, and stay within five rounds.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate fixes after task review.

prompt_templates.title: Complete final review and handoff preparation
prompt_templates.prompt: For [PLAN_PATH], review the latest branch state, include parked findings, verify records, and scan for secrets. Present rulings before human handoff.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a verified completion record.

output_examples.input: Execute an approved three-task plan in subagent mode.
output: Three tasks completed with implementation reports and task review verdicts.
Final review examined the latest branch state.
Execution records remain available for verification and human handoff.

output_examples.input: Resume a plan interrupted during its second task's fix loop.
output: The ledger identifies the first task as complete and the second task as mid-fix-loop.
The next fix round uses the recorded findings and available implementer context.
Completed work is not dispatched again.
The preflight ruling resolves an interface argument-order conflict against the specification.
A deferred review finding remains visible with its rationale and rework cost.
The human retains authority over merging, pushing, and publication.

best_practices: Confirm planning approval, task identifiers, specification access, and sibling dependencies before starting.
Resume from durable ledgers and recorded branch state rather than conversation memory.
Keep test evidence, review verdicts, and rulings complete; redact secrets before writing any artifact.
anti_patterns: Treating implementer success reports as substitutes for independent task review.
Repeating completed tasks or running multiple implementers in the same working tree.
Silently discarding findings, deleting execution records, or publishing without human authorization.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package declares Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support. Execution requires a host that supports the specified subagent workflow.

faq.question: What must be ready before execution?
faq.answer: An approved plan, identified tasks, a reachable specification, selected subagent mode, and required Executor dependencies must be available.

faq.question: Does this package include the workflow scripts?
faq.answer: No. The supplied files contain instructions and an implementer template. Workflow helpers and reviewer templates are referenced through sibling skills.

faq.question: How does interrupted work resume?
faq.answer: The controller checks durable task states, recorded dispatches, and branch history. It continues incomplete work rather than repeating completed tasks.

faq.question: What happens when reviews keep finding problems?
faq.answer: Tasks allow five fix rounds with scoped re-review. Remaining findings receive recorded rulings and remain visible during final review or handoff.

faq.question: Does completion allow automatic publication?
faq.answer: No. Security-sensitive and destructive actions require stopping. Initiative merging, pushing, and publication remain human decisions at handoff.
